full_judgment: 2. Facts, relevant for disposal of this Rule, in brief, are that, the plaintiff Jahangir Hossain Mollah, the seller of the suit property, had filed Title Suit No.8 of 2009 before the court of Assistant Judge, Uzirpur, Barisal against the defendant late Hosen Ali Bepari (purchaser of the suit property), seeking a decree for redemption oi the suit property, under the provisions of section 95A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (the SAT Act). The defendant Hosen Ali Bepari appeared and filed a written statement. Subsequently he died during pendency of this suit and his wife along with their 3 sons were substituted as defendant Nos. 1 (Ka) to 1 (Gha) and they have contested in the suit. The plaintiff had produced 4 witnesses, who were cross-examined by the other side. Besides, the plaintiff had adduced and proved certain documents which were marked as exhibits 1-6(1). On the other hand, the defendants produced 3 witnesses to support their case, who had deposed as DWs No. 1-3 and were cross-examined by the plaintiff's side. The defendants had produced and proved a registered deed No. 2475 dated 25-9-2001, marked as exhibit "Ka", which was, admittedly, executed by the plaintiff in favour of the defendant and they had also proved the certified copy of the SA Khatian No.270, marked as exhibit "Kha".
